content.user_title: Design Landing Pages With Clear Copy and Visual Rules
content.value_statement: Landing pages lose focus when copy, layout, and visual choices lack a shared plan. This skill guides audience intake, page structure, conversion copy, and consistent styling.
actual_capabilities: Gather the offer, audience, conversion goal, objections, proof, and brand constraints through a structured intake.
Recommend one of four page layouts and organize sections around a single primary action.
Draft hero copy, benefit bullets, three process steps, and six to twelve FAQ answers.
Specify named typography styles, spacing tokens, corner radii, icon choices, and animation behavior.
Recommend indexing choices, page titles, meta descriptions, and question and answer content.
Guide section by section implementation with interaction states, reduced motion support, and a 390px mobile checklist.
limitations: The skill provides instructions, not bundled scripts, components, or a deployment service.
It cannot guarantee conversion improvements, search rankings, or accessibility compliance.
Real prices, statistics, testimonials, and customer logos require user input or verified sources.
Its prescribed fonts, tokens, icons, and motion patterns may conflict with an existing design system.

use_cases.title: Plan a product launch page
use_cases.description: Define the audience, offer, signup action, and page outline before drafting launch copy.

use_cases.title: Align campaign messaging
use_cases.description: Match an advertising promise to hero copy, benefits, supporting proof, and a consistent primary action.

use_cases.title: Implement a consistent page
use_cases.description: Translate an approved outline into reusable text styles, spacing tokens, interaction states, and responsive sections.

prompt_templates.title: Start with a page brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Help plan a landing page for [product] aimed at [audience]. The primary action is [action]. Ask for missing details in one batch.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: clarify the offer and audience.

prompt_templates.title: Draft the page content
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an outline, hero copy, benefits, three process steps, and six FAQ answers for [offer]. Use only the supplied proof: [verified facts].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turn a brief into copy.

prompt_templates.title: Choose layout and search treatment
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend a layout for [offer] receiving [traffic source] traffic. Explain the choice, indexing recommendation, title, and meta description. Address these objections: [objections].
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: connect structure to traffic and intent.

prompt_templates.title: Build and review sections
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement the approved outline in [stack], section by section. Define reusable visual tokens. Include interaction states and reduced motion behavior. Check the 390px layout.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: implement and review an approved page.

output_examples.input: Plan a waitlist page for a scheduling tool for independent tutors. No testimonials are available.
output: Layout: Minimal conversion page for a focused early access offer.
Sections: Hero, benefits, tagline reveal, three process steps, FAQ, and final waitlist action.
Proof: Request a verified product screenshot. Do not invent testimonials or customer counts.

output_examples.input: Review a campaign page with competing buttons, missing focus states, and scroll animations.
output: Use one primary action above the fold and repeat it in the final section.
Add visible keyboard focus and specific inline error messages.
Replace movement with an opacity change when reduced motion is requested.
Show tagline text immediately at full color for reduced motion users.
Check the page at 390px for overflow and button text containment.

best_practices: Provide one audience, one offer, one primary action, and verified proof before drafting.
Approve the outline and copy before building each section.
Check keyboard focus, reduced motion behavior, and the 390px layout before release.
anti_patterns: Do not invent testimonials, customer logos, prices, or performance statistics for a real product.
Do not place competing primary actions above the fold.
Do not rebuild the entire page for every section change.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It guides page outlines, hero copy, benefits, process steps, FAQs, SEO recommendations, and section by section implementation.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: The listing supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. Implementation depends on the tools available in your assistant environment.

faq.question: Does it include ready made components?
faq.answer: No. The package contains a Markdown instruction file, not a component library or executable build system.

faq.question: Can it work without testimonials or pricing?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires clearly marked placeholders for missing real product facts instead of invented claims.

faq.question: Does it guarantee better conversions?
faq.answer: No. It supplies design and copy guidance. Conversion improvements require measurement and testing with your audience.

faq.question: How does it address mobile and accessibility?
faq.answer: It specifies a 390px layout check, focus states, semantic HTML, alt text, a skip link, and reduced motion behavior.
